blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision language models (VLMs) encode substantial expert knowledge within their weights, yet their direct application to specialised classification domains such as benthic imagery remains limited. Meanwhile, vision transformers trained on these tasks rely predominantly on low-level visual latents (colours, textures, and shapes) that lack the higher-level reasoning humans employ for identification. We propose Guided Hierarchical Multi-Label (GHiML) learning, a pipeline that extracts conceptual latent variables from a VLM conditioned on training data, generates sample-relevant captions grounded in those variables, and fuses the resulting textual embeddings with image embeddings via cross-attention and a per-node gated router. We also introduce the inverted HML score ($d_{\mathrm{inv}}$), a similarity score that evaluates hierarchical multi-label predictions through graph traversal distance and a cardinality penalty, providing an interpretable alternative to existing measures, which are insensitive to realistic degradations in sparse, deep hierarchies. Experiments on BenthicNet, FathomNet and iNaturalist show that the router improves macro $F_1$ over the vision-only baseline by up to 6.7 pp and $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ by up to 21.1 pp on in-domain benthic data, with gains persisting under distribution shift. Ablations locate the contribution of the text itself: on the multi-label biotic hierarchies, removing the per-sample text signal degrades $d_{\mathrm{inv}}$ while leaving macro $F_1$ unchanged, consistent with text acting through prediction cardinality rather than node discrimination, whereas iNaturalist, whose annotations are single-label, loses 18.7% of macro $F_1$. Our results support the hypothesis that VLMs contain exploitable specialised knowledge that, when appropriately elicited, can augment classification in domains where direct visual learning is insufficient.
blocks.zh: 远景语言模型(VLMs)在其权重范围内编码了大量的专家知识,但直接应用于海底图像等专门分类领域仍然有限。 同时,在这些任务方面受过培训的视变器主要依靠低等视觉潜伏物(颜色、纹理和外形),而这些潜伏物缺乏人类用于识别的更高级推理。 我们提议进行有指导的分层多标签学习,这是从以培训数据为条件的VLM中提取概念性潜在变量的管道,生成基于这些变量的与样本相关的标题,并将由此产生的文字嵌入与图像嵌入相通和每节门路由器相接而成。 我们还引入了倒转的HML分数(d_{\mathrm{inv}}$}}$),这是一个类似分数,它通过图轨相距来评价分级多标签的预测和最基本的惩罚,为现有的措施提供了一个可解释的替代方法,这些方法对稀有而深层次的现实退化不敏感. 在BenthicNet、FathomNet和iNaturalist上的实验显示,路由器将宏F_1美元高于仅视基线,最多可达6.7pp;在域内底栖数据上,可达21.1pp;在分配转移中,收益持续增加。 查找文本本身的贡献:在多标签生物分级上,去除每个样本的文本信号会降解$d_{\mathrm{inv}}$,而保留宏$F_1$不变,与文本通过预测核心作用而不是节点区分作用一致,而iNaturalist作为单标签的说明,损失了宏$F_1$的18.7%. 我们的结果支持这样的假设,即:VLM包含可被利用的专门知识,这些知识在适当引出后,可以在直接视觉学习不足的领域加强分类。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: For general tasks, vision language models (VLMs) have seen widespread adoption ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . However, recent research suggests that out-of-the-box VLMs remain limited in their application to specialised domains such as ocean and medical sciences ( Wong et al., 2025 ; Nath et al., 2025 ) . Consequently, in conjunction with more traditional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) ( Fukushima, 1980 ; He et al., 2016 ) , vision transformers (ViTs) ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) remain the standard for classification tasks in these research areas ( Langenkämper et al., 2017 ; Battach et al., 2025 ; Lowe et al., 2025 ; Aburass et al., 2025 ) . Vision neural networks tend to work through the extraction of low-level latent variables (latents), such as colours, textures, and shapes ( Zeiler and Fergus, 2014 ; Geirhos et al., 2019 ; Raghu et al., 2021 ; Ribeiro et al., 2016 ) , resembling the hierarchical visual cortex ( Fukushima, 1980 ) . However, these latents lack the generalisable reasoning characteristics that humans use to identify objects. The lack of reasoning in visual tasks within specialised domains therefore remains a research gap. This motivation is illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 就一般任务而言,视觉语言模型(VLMs)已得到广泛采用(Radford等,2021;Alayrac等,2022;Yang等,2025)。 然而,最近的研究表明,在诸如海洋和医学等专门领域应用的VLM不完全(Wong等人,2025年;Nath等人,2025年)。 因此,结合更传统的革命神经网络(CNNs)(福岛,1980;He等,2016.),视变器(ViTs)(多索维茨基等,2021.)仍然是这些研究领域分类任务的标准(Langenkämper等,2017;Battach等,2025;Lowe等,2025;Aburass等,2025.). 视觉神经网络往往通过取出低等潜在变量(纬度)来工作,如颜色,纹理,外形等(Zeiler and Fergus,2014;Geirhos等,2019;Raghu等,2021;Ribeiro等,2016),类似分级视觉皮层(福岛,1980). 然而,这些潜伏物缺乏人类用来识别物体的通俗推理特征. 因此,在专门领域的视觉任务中缺乏推理仍然是一个研究空白。 图1说明了这一动机。

blocks.en: Our application domain, benthic (seafloor) imagery classification, supports ecological and economic monitoring of maritime environments under increasing anthropogenic pressure ( Scovil et al., 2025 ) , at a data volume that far exceeds the capacity of manual analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们的应用领域 -- -- 海底(海底)图象分类 -- -- 支持在人类压力越来越大的情况下对海洋环境进行生态和经济监测(Scovil等,2025年),数据量远远超过人工分析能力。

blocks.en: Benthic image classification is often a hierarchical multi-label (HML) task ( Katija et al., 2022 ; Lowe et al., 2025 ) , meaning a single image may contain multiple organism subjects or substrate types, each situated within a taxonomic or visually derived hierarchy that spans broad morphological categories down to fine-grained species-level distinctions. This combination of multi-label outputs and structured hierarchical dependencies poses challenges that extend beyond standard image classification ( Giunchiglia and Lukasiewicz, 2020 ; Wehrmann et al., 2018 ) . The problem is further compounded by substantial visual variability in seafloor imagery, arising from inconsistent lighting conditions, colour casts, and diverse substrate appearances, all of which undermine the robustness of learned representations ( Lowe et al., 2025 ; Katija et al., 2022 ; Battach et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2021 ; Langenkämper et al., 2017 ) . Moreover, rare classes, often those of the greatest ecological interest, remain poorly understood and difficult to detect by existing HML methods, as limited training examples prevent models from confidently learning discriminative features ( Xu et al., 2024 ) . Collectively, these factors make benthic image classification a particularly demanding domain in which current approaches struggle to achieve the robustness and reliability that ecological monitoring demands.
blocks.zh: Benthic图像分类通常是一种分级多标签(HML)任务(Katija等,2022;Lowe等,2025),指单个图像可能包含多个有机体主体或底物类型,每个都位于一个分类或视觉衍生的分层中,分出从广义形态分类到细纹物种层次区分. 这种多标签产出和结构化的分级依赖的组合带来了超越标准图像分类的挑战(Giunchiglia和Lukasiewicz,2020;Wermann等,2018年). 由于照明条件不统一、彩色铸造和下层外观多样,使海底图像的视觉差异更为复杂,所有这些都破坏了所学表现的稳健性(Lowe等人,2025年;Katija等人,2022年;Battach等人,2025年;Chen等人,2021年;Langenkämper等人,2017年)。 此外,罕见的班级,往往是生态兴趣最强的班级,对于现有的HML方法仍然认识不足并难以发现,因为有限的培训实例使模型无法自信地学习歧视性特征(徐等,2024年). 这些因素共同使海底图像分类成为一个要求特别高的领域,在这个领域,目前的方法难以达到生态监测所要求的稳健性和可靠性。

blocks.en: In an effort to improve robustness in image detection for this domain, we propose G uided Hi erarchical M ulti- L abel (GHiML) learning, an approach that seeks to unite the general knowledge contained in large VLMs with the specialised training of ViTs. GHiML consists of four steps: (1) identifying high-level latents relevant to reasoning about the domain, data points, and their annotations, (2) generating sample-relevant captions for extracted latents, (3) cross-attention fusion between image embeddings and generated textual embeddings for downstream classification, and (4) training a gated mixture of all three modalities across classes (hierarchical nodes). Our hypothesis is that the relationships between tokens encoded in a sufficiently trained VLM contain useful oceanographic connections beyond what low-level visual latents represent. Conditioning on those latents then helps to elicit this stored knowledge as a sample-specific textual signal.
blocks.zh: 为了提高这个领域图像探测的稳健性,我们提出G uided Hi erarchical Multi-L abel(GHiML)学习,这种方法寻求将大型甚高频中包含的一般知识与ViTs的专门培训相统一. GHIML由四个步骤组成:(1) 确定与域内推理相关的高层次潜入,数据点及其说明;(2) 为所提取潜入物生成与样本相关的标题;(3) 为下游分类在图像嵌入和生成文字嵌入之间进行交叉注意相聚;(4) 培训所有三种模式的门式混合型(分级节点). 我们的假设是,在一个训练有素的VLM中编码的符号之间的关系包含一些有用的海洋学联系,超出了低等视觉潜想所代表的范围。 对这些潜在物的限定有助于将这种储存的知识作为特定样本的文字信号。

blocks.en: Additionally, we propose an evaluation score for HML predictions, based on graph traversal distance and comparisons of multi-label cardinality (the degree of “multi-labelled-ness”) ( Tsoumakas and Katakis, 2009 ) between prediction and annotation. We refer to it as the inverted HML score ( d inv d_{\text{inv}} ), a bounded similarity score ranging from 0 to 1, where higher values indicate better predictions. In practice, d inv d_{\text{inv}} is reported alongside the node-wise (macro-averaged) F 1 F_{1} score ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . The two evaluate different objects, with F 1 F_{1} scoring per-node detection and d inv d_{\text{inv}} scoring the predicted label set as a whole, and we do not treat either as a substitute for the other.

A use-inspired pipeline that elicits domain knowledge from a VLM as a sample-specific textual signal and integrates it with an existing HML framework, rather than a new HML method in itself; 2. d inv d_{\text{inv}} , an evaluation score for HML predictions that accounts for both hierarchical proximity and prediction cardinality; and 3. An analysis of what the elicited text contributes, which we find acts as a coarse prior over regions of the hierarchy rather than as a discriminative signal within them.

blocks.en: In HML, annotations may be envisioned as a path starting from a root and terminating at a node. Multi-label implies that these annotations can consist of any combination of viable paths. blocks.en: To summarise our models, we train self-attention-based pooling mechanisms to transform sequential image and text embeddings into dense vectors. These unimodal models serve as baselines and reveal the overlap between textual and visual performance, specifically the degree to which each modality carries redundant or complementary information. A third cross-attention mechanism is trained with image as the query modality and text as the key-value modality 2 2 2 In preliminary testing, image querying text performed stronger than the reverse. . Finally, we train a router ( Jacobs et al., 1991 ) that takes as input the concatenated pooled embeddings and outputs softmax weights over the three modalities for each node, so that the contribution of each modality may vary by node and by sample. We run two versions of this router: one that loads frozen pretrained pooling layers from our unimodal runs and trains the classifiers and router mechanism (Router), and one with all parameters trained from scratch (Router † ).
blocks.zh: 为了总结我们的模型,我们训练基于自我的集合机制,将相继的图像和文本嵌入转化为密集的向量. 这些单式模型可作为基线,揭示出文字性能和视觉性能之间的重叠,具体来说,是每种模式携带多余或补充信息的程度。 在初步测试中,图像查询文本的表现比反向更强。 最后,我们培训一个路由器(Jacobs等,1991年),将每个节点的三种模式上相接的集合嵌入和输出软马克斯权重作为投入,这样,每种模式的贡献可能因节点和样本而异. 我们运行着两个版本的路由器:一个是从我们的单模式运行中装入被冷冻的预先训练的集合层并训练分级器和路由器机制(路由器)的;另一个是从零开始装入所有参数的(路由器).

blocks.en: Evaluating HML predictions requires a score that captures both closeness between prediction and ground truth and multi-label cardinality , penalising predictions that are deficient or excessive, given that real-world annotations may be incomplete ( Lowe et al., 2025 ; Katija et al., 2022 ) . Existing scores do not fully satisfy these requirements. Node-wise F 1 F_{1} penalises cardinality errors but forfeits hierarchical proximity, particularly at standard 0.5 0.5 thresholding, where deeper nodes frequently score zero regardless of prediction closeness ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Micro-averaged AP ( Giunchiglia and Lukasiewicz, 2020 ; Wehrmann et al., 2018 ) pools across all nodes, so evaluation in sparse hierarchies lets easily ranked negatives dominate, producing overly optimistic scores. A comparison of these scores is presented in Appendix I .

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据集

blocks.en: We evaluate on three datasets, described in full in Appendix C . BenthicNet ( Lowe et al., 2025 ) provides 188,679 annotated images labelled under the CATAMI scheme ( Althaus et al., 2015 ) , from which we form two overlapping tasks, substrate (BN-Sub, 23 nodes) and biota (BN-Bio, 293 nodes). FathomNet (2025) (FN) ( 10 ) is a benthic biota competition dataset of 9,305 full images, for which we extracted a 192-node taxonomic hierarchy from WoRMS ( WoRMS Editorial Board, 2026 ) , making the problem HML (full-depth). For both, the innate test partitions serve as out-of-domain (OOD) test sets, and we additionally construct in-domain (ID) test sets from a random 20% of the data. These partitions are “OOD” because BenthicNet’s test set is geospatially partitioned and FathomNet’s competition test set was hand-selected. Lastly, iNaturalist (iNat) ( Van Horn et al., 2018 ) spans terrestrial fauna, flora, and fungi with single-label annotations over a hierarchy of over 16,000 nodes; we train on the 500,000 training samples of iNat (mini) and test on its 100,000 validation samples, replacing MCLoss with a softmax over the 10,000 endpoints, marginalised up the hierarchy. Since each prediction and annotation consists of exactly one endpoint, n E = 0 n_{\text{E}}=0 and γ ≡ 1 \gamma\equiv 1 , so d inv d_{\text{inv}} reduces to normalised traversal similarity on this dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们对附录C所全面描述的三个数据集进行评价。 BenthicNet(Lowe等,2025年)提供了188,679个附加注释的图像,标注在CATAMI方案(Althaus等,2015年)之下,我们从中形成了两个重叠的任务:下层(BN-Sub,23个节点)和生物区(BN-Bio,293个节点)。 FathomNet (2025)(FN)(10 )是一个由9,305个完整图像组成的海底生物群竞争数据集,我们为此从WoRMS(WoRMS编辑委员会,2026年)中提取出192个节点分类分层,使问题HML(完全深度). 对两者来说,先天测试分区作为域外(OOD)测试集,我们从随机的20%的数据中额外构建域内(ID)测试集. 这些分区是"OOD",因为BenthicNet的测试集是地理空间分区的,而FathomNet的竞争测试集是手取的. 最后,iNaturalist(iNat)(Van Horn等,2018年)以单一标签说明覆盖了陆地动物、植物和真菌,覆盖了超过16 000个节点的分级;我们培训了500,000个iNat(mini)的训练样本,并对其10万个验证样本进行了测试,在10,000个分级点上用软max取代了MCLoss,使分级边缘化。 由于每个预测和注释都包含一个完全的终点,n E = 0 n_{\text{E}}=0和 γ 1\gamma\equiv 1,所以d inv d_{\text{inv}}}在这个数据集中降低为正态的转折相似性.

blocks.en: As shown in Table 1 , the router models achieve the strongest performance in nearly all settings. The ranking across methods is consistent for each metric across all random seeds. Although text underperforms vision on F 1 F_{1} at nearly every node, the two metrics disagree in a specific way: at 75 of the 171 BN-Bio nodes with sufficient support, text scores higher on d inv d_{\text{inv}} while failing to identify the node on F 1 F_{1} , against 6 nodes where the reverse holds. This indicates that text contributes generalisable semantic information about where predictions belong in the hierarchy, rather than finer discrimination between nodes.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,路由器模型在几乎所有的设置中都实现了最强的性能. 对所有随机种子的每个度量,不同方法的排名一致。 虽然文本在F1 FQQQ1}上几乎在每个节点上表现不佳,但两个公尺在具体方式上有分歧:在171个BN-Bio节点中的75个有足够的支持,文本在d inv d_{\text{inv}} 上得分较高而未能识别出F1 FQQQ1}上的节点,而反之有6个节点. 这表明,文本有助于提供一般性的语义信息,说明预测属于何种等级,而不是在节点之间作出更细微的区分。

blocks.en: One contributing factor is that several of the selected variables encode functional traits, such as mobility, attachment strategy, and predation mode, that are particularly informative for sessile organisms. Algae and sponges, for instance, share many such traits, and the resulting captions place them in close proximity within the hierarchy even when exact classification fails.
blocks.zh: 一个促成因素是,一些选定的变量编码了功能特征,如流动性、附件策略和预置模式,这些变量对沉滞生物特别具有信息性。 例如,藻类和海绵具有许多这样的特征,因此,即使准确分类失败,它们也处于等级制度的相近位置。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the same comparison on iNat, where the hierarchy is roughly 55 55 times larger and annotations are single-label. The ordering is unchanged: both routers exceed the image branch on both metrics at every seed, and text alone remains the weakest by a wide margin on F 1 F_{1} while retaining half of the image branch’s d inv d_{\text{inv}} . Because d inv d_{\text{inv}} has no cardinality term on iNat, this is a direct measure of proximity. A text stream with poor F 1 F_{1} on its own still places predictions within reach of the target.

blocks.en: We next ask whether text and vision contribute distinct information, and whether the router successfully exploits both. Among the top-performing nodes for text, there is low overlap between the two modalities, and the router frequently surpasses vision while retaining a margin of advantage comparable to that of text alone ( Appendix H ). There, we also study the relevant variables and their correlations with text advantage, as well as with individual nodes. We observe that the proposed variables provide strong contextual information that benefits classification, even when they do not directly improve prediction of the original nodes with which they were associated via KL divergence.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来要问的是,文本和愿景是否提供了不同的信息,路由器是否成功地利用了两者。 在文本方面表现最优的节点中,两种模式之间的重叠程度较低,路由器经常会超越视觉,同时保留与文本相比的优势幅度(附录H)。 在那里,我们还研究了相关的变量及其与文本优势以及单个节点的相关性. 我们注意到,拟议的变量提供了强有力的背景信息,有利于分类,即使这些变量没有直接改善通过KL差异与其相联系的原始节点的预测。

blocks.en: This last point warrants emphasis. Although variables were assigned to modal nodes, the captions they generate encode a far richer set of combinations. The variable ambush , for example, was initially selected for its association with sea stars. In practice, it also describes rocky substrates (habitats in which ambush predators tend to occur), detects lobsters (themselves ambush predators), and identifies organisms or environments facilitating camouflage consistent with ambush strategy. A single functional concept thus provides signal across multiple nodes. This is consistent with considering ecological function and context rather than relying solely on low-level visual latents such as colour and texture.
blocks.zh: 最后一点值得强调。 虽然变量被分配到模式节点,但是它们产生的标题编码是一套更丰富的组合. 例如,可变伏击最初是因其与海星的联系而被选中的。 在实务中,它也描述了多岩石的地基(埋伏捕食者往往在其中出没的栖息地),检测龙虾(它们自己埋伏捕食者),并识别出有利于与埋伏策略相符合的伪装的生物或环境. 因此,一个单一的功能概念提供跨越多个节点的信号. 这与考虑生态功能和上下文是一致的,而不是仅仅依赖低等视觉潜质,如颜色和纹理.

blocks.en: 4.3 Text as a Sub-Tree Prior

blocks.en: Beyond the trained branches, we also examine the embeddings themselves. blocks.en: 5 Related Works
blocks.zh: 5 相关工程

blocks.en: Our work is influenced by the causal discovery literature, most notably COAT ( Liu et al., 2024 ) . COAT employs LLMs to discover a phenomenon’s Markov Blanket by proposing candidate variables and annotating each sample with a trinary encoding per variable (relevant, irrelevant, or inversely relevant). COAT demonstrates that LLMs can actively mediate between unstructured observations and structured representations. Our pipeline differs in that we target hierarchical multi-label classification, select variables per hierarchy node by KL divergence, and have a VLM score each variable with a brief visual justification. The resulting captions are embedded as dense text and fused with the image representation through a learned per-node router, so the variables serve as contextual signal for a vision model and are never used as discrete features for causal analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们的作品受到因果发现文献的影响,最出名的是COAT(刘等,2024. COAT使用LLMs来发现现象的Markov Blanket, 方法是提出候选变量, COAT表明,LLMs可以在无结构的观察和有结构的表述之间积极调解. 我们的管道不同,因为我们的目标是分级多标签分类,用KL分数选择每个分级节点的变量,并且每个变量有一个VLM分数,并有一个简短的可视化理由. 由此产生的标题被嵌入为稠密的文字,并通过一个学习到的每个节点路由器来与图像表达相融合,因此变量作为视觉模型的上下文信号,从未被用作因果分析的离散特征.

blocks.en: Closer in line with our motivation are diffusion-based augmentation strategies ( Yerramilli et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Trabucco et al., 2024 ; Samuel et al., 2024 ) , which leverage the visual priors of large-scale generative models to augment downstream classification. SGID ( Li et al., 2024 ) uses BLIP-generated captions ( Li et al., 2023 ) and CLIP-based selection ( Radford et al., 2021 ) to guide Stable Diffusion toward class-consistent samples, DA-Fusion ( Trabucco et al., 2024 ) semantically augments real images via Stable Diffusion, and SeedSelect ( Samuel et al., 2024 ) optimises the initial noise seed to improve rare class generation. However, these approaches are largely inapplicable to benthic habitat classification, where many taxa remain underrepresented in the web-scale data on which diffusion models are trained ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Instead, much of our knowledge of benthic taxa and habitat is encoded textually, motivating our alternative strategy of extracting higher-level semantic information from a VLM rather than synthesising novel training samples.

blocks.en: Within the HML literature, research into improving detection and addressing class imbalance remains sparse, with existing methods broadly employing either resampling techniques ( Pereira et al., 2021 ) or weighted objectives ( Xu et al., 2026 ) . Our work enhances node detection broadly by leveraging the general knowledge of an external foundation model.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We have presented GHiML, a pipeline for extracting and leveraging higher-level semantic knowledge from VLMs to augment hierarchical multi-label classification in specialised visual domains. Through a structured variable proposal, EM-based filtering, and sample-conditioned captioning procedure, we demonstrated that a VLM can be positioned to generate complementary contextual information to standard visual features. The gated router architecture exploits this information on a per-node basis, consistently outperforming both unimodal baselines and the cross-attention fusion model across two benthic datasets under both in-domain and out-of-domain considerations, and on iNat.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了GHIML,这是从VLMs中提取和利用更高层次语义知识的管道,以加强专门视觉领域的分级多标签分类。 通过结构化的可变建议,基于EM的过滤,以及具有样本条件的字幕程序,我们证明了一个VLM可以被定位以生成与标准视觉特征相互补的上下文信息. 闸口路由器架构利用这种信息,在域内和域外的考虑下,在iNat上,单式基线和两套底栖数据集的跨心聚变模式都一直比此高。

blocks.en: We additionally introduced d inv d_{\text{inv}} , a metric that grounds HML evaluation in the structure of the hierarchy itself. By combining graph traversal distance with an explicit cardinality penalty governed by a single interpretable parameter, d inv d_{\text{inv}} addresses gaps left by existing methods, and offers an intuitive understanding of model performance. Limitations of the work are discussed in greater detail in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 我们又引入了 d v d_{\text{inv}}}, 这个衡量标准可以证明在等级结构本身中 HML 的评价 。 d inv d_{\text{inv}}}通过将图相向相向的距离与由单一可解释参数规范的明确的重刑相结合,解决了由现有方法所留下的差距,并提供了对模型性能的直观理解. 附录F更详细地讨论了工作的局限性。

blocks.en: A.1 Attention-Based Pooling

blocks.en: We consider two architectures for producing a fixed-dimensional representation from variable-length token sequences, both sharing a common structure consisting of a contextual encoding stage followed by learned query attention pooling. In the self-attention pooling variant, given an input sequence 𝐗 ∈ ℝ n b × T × d \mathbf{X}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\text{b}}\times T\times d} of batch size n b n_{\text{b}} , sequence length T T , and embedding dimension d d , we first apply multi-headed (four heads) self-attention with residual connections and layer normalisation ( Ba et al., 2016 ) , followed by a position-wise feed-forward network, yielding a contextually enriched sequence 𝐗 ~ ∈ ℝ n b × T × d \tilde{\mathbf{X}}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\text{b}}\times T\times d} . In the cross-attention fusion variant, two distinct token sequences are available, a query sequence 𝐗 q ∈ ℝ n b × N × d \mathbf{X}_{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\text{b}}\times N\times d} (image embeddings) and a key-value sequence 𝐗 k ​ v ∈ ℝ n b × M × d \mathbf{X}_{kv}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\text{b}}\times M\times d} (text embeddings), and we replace the self-attention encoder with an analogous cross-attention layer in which 𝐗 q \mathbf{X}_{q} attends over 𝐗 k ​ v \mathbf{X}_{kv} , followed by the same residual connections, layer normalisation, and feed-forward network, producing a fused sequence 𝐗 ~ q ∈ ℝ n b × N × d \tilde{\mathbf{X}}_{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{\text{b}}\times N\times d} that integrates information from 𝐗 k ​ v \mathbf{X}_{kv} into the positions of 𝐗 q \mathbf{X}_{q} . In both cases, the final pooling stage is identical: a single learnable query parameter 𝐪 ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{q}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} attends over the encoded sequence via multi-head cross-attention, followed by layer normalisation, yielding a fixed-dimensional representation 𝐳 ∈ ℝ d \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} . Padding masks are propagated through all attention stages to ensure that padded positions contribute neither to contextual encoding nor to the final pooled representation. The resulting vector 𝐳 \mathbf{z} is subsequently passed to an HML constrained feed-forward classifier.

blocks.en: C.1 BenthicNet
blocks.zh: C.1 本思网

blocks.en: BenthicNet ( Lowe et al., 2025 ) is one of the largest publicly available ocean science datasets, comprising over 11 million benthic images aggregated from 2,058 constituent datasets spanning a wide variety of geographic regions, depth ranges, and imaging platforms, sourced from research groups and government agencies around the world. Its label taxonomy follows the Collaborative and Annotation Tools for Analysis of Marine Imagery (CATAMI) visual classification scheme ( Althaus et al., 2015 ) , and is unique in that annotations span both substrate and biota categories, facilitating both habitat and organism classification. We draw from it its full set of annotated imagery (188,679 images), forming two overlapping subsets for substrate and biota (BN-Sub and BN-Bio, respectively), which we treat as independent classification tasks. BN-Sub contains 23 nodes while BN-Bio contains 293. BenthicNet’s test partition is geospatially subsampled, meaning test images originate from regions unseen during training. We refer to this innate partition as the out-of-domain (OOD) test set, and additionally construct an in-domain (ID) test set through random stratified sampling (of 20% of the data) for evaluation under more conventional conditions. The combination of global geographic coverage and diversity across both biota and substrate categories makes BenthicNet a suitable testbed for HML methods that must generalise across heterogeneous visual conditions.
blocks.zh: BenthicNet(Lowe等人,2025年)是最大的可公开获取的海洋科学数据集之一,由来自世界各地研究团体和政府机构的2,058个广泛地理区域、深度和成像平台组成数据集的1,100多万个海底图像组成。 其标签分类学遵循了分析海洋图像的协作和注释工具(CATAMI)视觉分类计划(Althaus等,2015年),在说明中具有独特性,既包括底物类别,也包括生物群类别,有利于生境和生物的分类。 我们从中抽取了它的全套注解图象(188,679图象),组成了底物和生物群的两个相重叠的子集(分别为BN-Sub和BN-Bio),我们把它视为独立的分类任务. BN-Sub包含23个节点,而BN-Bio包含293个. BenthicNet的测试分区是地理空间分样的,意思是测试图像来自训练期间未见的区域。 我们把这种内生分接称为域外(OO)测试集,并通过随机分层抽样(占数据的20%)额外构建一个域内(ID)测试集,用于在更常规的条件下进行评价。 全球地理覆盖和生物区系和底物类别的多样性相结合,使BenthicNet成为HML方法的合适试验床,必须跨越不同的视觉条件。

blocks.en: C.2 FathomNet (2025)
blocks.zh: C.2 法特洪网(2025年)

blocks.en: FathomNet (2025) (FN) ( 10 ) is a benthic biota classification competition dataset consisting of 9,305 full images and 24,487 regions-of-interest (ROIs). Full images may contain multiple ROIs. The dataset is not inherently hierarchical, despite using taxonomic annotations. Furthermore, it has been curated to be balanced across classes. We extracted a hierarchy of 192 nodes spanning phylum, class, order, family, genus, and species 4 4 4 For some annotations, these levels were replaced with a sub-level alternative where necessary. from the World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS) ( WoRMS Editorial Board, 2026 ) . Subsequently, the classes in the dataset become leaf nodes, and the problem becomes HML (full-depth). While earlier imagery from FathomNet was contained in BenthicNet, the 2025 competition dataset is novel with a carefully curated OOD test set ( Lowe et al., 2025 ; 10 ). As with BenthicNet, we use both the innate test partition and a random partition (of 20%) for OOD and ID evaluation respectively.

blocks.en: C.3 iNaturalist
blocks.zh: C.3 iNaturalist 单词

blocks.en:
To demonstrate the generalisability of the proposed approach, experiments are also performed on the iNaturalist (iNat) ( Van Horn et al., 2018 ) dataset. The iNat dataset encompasses a broader domain than BenthicNet, capturing terrestrial fauna, flora, and fungi. Additionally, it presents a distinct structural classification challenge. While the dataset inherently contains 10,000 distinct species classes, its biological taxonomic hierarchy allows for the construction of a hierarchical classification problem spanning over 16,000 nodes, characterised by mutually exclusive, single-label assignments.
In adapting our framework for iNat, we replace MCLoss with a softmax over the 10,000 endpoints, marginalised up the hierarchy, so that each node receives the summed probability of its descendants and the hierarchical structure is preserved. Training occurs on the 500,000 samples from iNat (mini), and the 100,000 validation samples act as a test set (since the true test partition is not publicly available).
blocks.zh:
为了证明拟议方法的可通用性,还在iNaturalist(iNat)(Van Horn等,2018年)数据集上进行了实验. iNat数据集涵盖比BenthicNet更广泛的领域,捕捉到陆地动物、植物和真菌。 此外,它提出了明显的结构分类挑战。 虽然数据集内在包含一万个不同的物种类别,但其生物分类等级结构允许构建跨越16 000多个节点的分级分类问题,其特点是相互排斥的单一标签分配。
在为iNat调整我们的框架时,我们用一万个端点的软max来取代MCLoss,使分级被边缘化,使每个节点都得到其后人的总和概率并保存分级结构. 对来自iNat(mini)的50万个样本进行培训,10万个验证样本作为测试集(因为真正的测试分区不公开).

blocks.en: F.1 Variable Proposal and Captioning
blocks.zh: F.1 可变提案和说明

blocks.en: The quality of proposed variables and captions is bounded by the VLM’s pretraining corpus. Domains or taxa that are poorly represented in training data may yield superficial or inaccurate variables, and the model’s familiarity is not uniform across the label space. Well-studied organisms (e.g., hard corals) are likely to be better detected than understudied groups (e.g., soft corals), introducing a systematic bias in caption informativeness.
blocks.zh: 拟议的变量和标题的质量以自愿培训大纲的预训书为限。 培训数据中代表性差的领域或分类可能会产生表面或不准确的变量,而且该模型在标签空间的熟悉程度并不一致。 研究良好的生物体(如硬珊瑚)可能比研究不足的群体(如软珊瑚)更能被检测出,在标题信息性上引入了系统性偏差.

blocks.en: The uniform per-node budget B B and conservative variable selection reflect pragmatic constraints imposed by the limited token capacity of smaller VLMs. When provided with too many variables, models at this scale tend to anchor onto variable names without meaningful contextual processing ( Shi et al., 2023 ; Wei et al., 2023 ) . A larger VLM or a multi-pass captioning scheme could improve caption quality. Lastly, while it may only need to be performed once, the captioning cost may be quite high, as demonstrated in Table 4 . Computation cost in this step can also vary significantly depending on the phrasing used in the prompt.
blocks.zh: B节点预算的统一B和保守的可变选择反映了较小的VLM的象征性能力有限所造成的实际限制。 当提供过多的变量时,这个尺度的模型往往会固定在可变名称上而不进行有意义的上下文处理(Shi等,2023;Wei等,2023.). 较大的VLM或多路字幕计划可以提高字幕质量. 最后,虽然可能只需要做一次,但如表4所示,标题费用可能相当高。 此步骤的计算成本也可能因提示中使用的用词而相差很大.

blocks.en: F.2 Architecture and Training
blocks.zh: F.2 建筑和培训

blocks.en: The text and image embedding models (Qwen3-Embedding-8B and DINOv3 ViT-H respectively) are frozen throughout training. Their representation spaces are therefore not adapted to the target domain, and any distributional mismatch between pretraining data and benthic imagery is inherited by the downstream classifier. Fine-tuning these backbones could improve performance but would substantially increase computational requirements and reduce accessibility for domain-specialised labs with limited hardware.
blocks.zh: 文字和图像嵌入模型(分别是Quen3-Embedding-8B和DINOv3 Vit-H)在整个训练过程中被冻结. 因此,它们的表示空间不适应目标领域,预训数据和底栖图像之间的任何分布不匹配由下游分级器继承. 精细调整这些主干线可以提高性能,但会大大增加计算要求,并减少硬件有限的域名专用实验室的可访问性.

blocks.en: The router models introduce additional parameters relative to the unimodal baselines (by a factor of 3, given each stream, and the router mechanism), and one variant (Router) loads pretrained pooling layers from unimodal runs. We therefore assess the text contribution with ablations that hold the architecture and parameter count fixed while removing the per-sample text signal ( subsection 4.3 ; subsection G.2 ).
blocks.zh: 路由器模型引入了与单模式基线相关的额外参数(按照每条流的因数为3,以及路由器机制),还有一个变体(路由器)从单模式运行中加载了预先训练的集合层. 因此,我们在评估文本贡献时,会使用将架构和参数计数固定下来并去除每个样本的文本信号(第4.3分节;G.2分节)。

blocks.en: F.3 Evaluation Scope
blocks.zh: F.3 评价范围

blocks.en: Our benthic experiments, our primary application focus, are restricted to two datasets (BenthicNet ( Lowe et al., 2025 ) and FathomNet ( Katija et al., 2022 ; 10 )), which represent the few large-scale, globally diverse, and taxonomically broad benchmarks available in this field. Beyond the benthic domain, we evaluate only on iNaturalist. While the core methodology does not rely on domain-specific assumptions, its extension to other specialised domains, such as medical imaging, remains empirically undemonstrated and is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 我们的海底实验,即我们的主要应用重点,仅限于两个数据集(BenthicNet(Lowe等人,2025年)和FathomNet(Katija等人,2022年;10年)),它们代表了这一领域现有的少数大规模、全球多样性和分类广泛基准。 在海底领域之外,我们只在iNaturalist上进行评估。 核心方法虽然不依赖特定领域假设,但推广到医学成像等其他专门领域,在经验上仍无证据可言,留待未来工作处理.

blocks.en: F.4 Evaluation Metric
blocks.zh: F.4 评价计量

blocks.en: The inverted HML score d inv d_{\text{inv}} relies on a user-specified parameter k P k_{\text{P}} that governs the severity of the cardinality penalty. Our choice of k P = 0.5 k_{\text{P}}=0.5 represents a balanced default. Where the expected unannotated multi-label cardinality of a dataset is suspected, k P k_{\text{P}} can be adjusted to reflect it.

Additionally, d inv d_{\text{inv}} treats all edges in the hierarchy as having unit weight, which may not reflect the true semantic distance between nodes. For example, the distinction between two congeneric species is typically far smaller than that between two phyla, yet both correspond to two edge traversals in a taxonomic tree. Depth-specific edge weights could be incorporated where expert knowledge provides meaningful inter-node distances, but we do not explore this idea in this work.
blocks.zh: 此外,d inv d_{\text{inv}}}将分级中的所有边缘都视为有单位权重,这可能不能反映节点之间的真实语义距离. 例如,两个同系物种之间的区别通常要小于两个同系物种之间的区别,然而两者都对应于一个分类树上的两个边缘曲面. 在专家知识提供有意义的节点间距离时,可以纳入深度特定边重,但我们在这项工作中并不探讨这一想法。

blocks.en: A natural question is whether the VLM can perform the classification directly, without the elicitation and training pipeline. We evaluate this on BenthicNet in two prompting regimes under greedy decoding, and report structural information rather than performance ( Table 9 ).

blocks.en: Free-form output cannot be scored. Both macro F 1 F_{1} and d inv d_{\text{inv}} require an ancestor-closed subset of 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , whereas the VLM emits unconstrained text. Matching that text back to the scheme recovers 0.10 nodes per image on BN-Sub and 0.87 on BN-Bio, against ground truth cardinalities of 1.42 and 3.09. Only 0.5% and 3.3% of emitted terms correspond to any CATAMI category, and 92.0% and 77.6% of images yield no scheme-conformant prediction at all. Any score reported under this regime would be a property of the matching rule rather than of the model.
blocks.zh: Free-form 输出不能得分 。 宏 F 1 F_{1}和 d inv d_{\text{inv}}} 都需要一个父系闭合子集 V\ mathcal{V}, 而 VLM 释放出不受约束的文本 。 将该文本与计划相匹配后,BN-Sub上的每个图像可恢复0.10个节点,BN-Bio上的0.87个节点,与1.42和3.09的地面真理基本点相对应。 只有0.5%和3.3%,符合任何类的CATAMI, 92.0%和77.6%的图像完全没有符合计划的预测。 根据这一制度报告的任何分数都属于匹配规则而不是模型的财产。

blocks.en: Supplying the vocabulary in the prompt helps with conformance but worsens cardinality. Conformance rises to 99.9% on BN-Sub and 98.0% on BN-Bio, while predicted cardinality inflates to 2.08 and 6.98 times ground truth. On BN-Bio the failure is bimodal: the median image returns 6 categories, 6.3% return more than 54, and the worst case returns 148 against a single annotated endpoint. This is the regime d inv d_{\text{inv}} penalises and micro-averaged AP tolerates ( Appendix I ): conformant predictions that share correct ancestors while carrying almost no discriminative information. It is also the reason a per-node budget B B is necessary ( Appendix E ), since instability scales with the size of the vocabulary placed in the prompt.
blocks.zh: 及时提供词汇有助于符合要求,但使基本情况恶化。 在BN-Sub和98.0%的BN-Bio中,遵守率分别上升到99.9%和98.0%,而预测的临界值则膨胀到2.08和6.98倍。 在 BN-Bio 上,失败是双向的:中位图像返回6个类别,6.3%返回54个以上,最糟糕的情况是返回148个附加说明的终点。 这是dv d_{\text{inv}}} 惩罚和微平均值AP 容忍的制度(附录一): 一致的预测, 分享正确的祖先, 这也是每个节点的预算B之所以有必要的原因(附录E),因为不稳定的程度与迅速输入的词汇大小相当。

blocks.en: Neither regime yields a usable classifier. Knowledge held in the weights does not make a specialised label space available as a prediction target, which motivates using the VLM to elicit properties rather than to predict nodes.
blocks.zh: 这两种制度都没有产生可用的分类器。 在权重中掌握的知识并不能使专门的标签空间成为预测目标,这就促使人们利用VLM来引出属性而不是预测节点.

Architecture, embedding dimensionality and trainable parameter count are held constant, and the model trains from the start on an uninformative stream, free to disregard it in favour of the image branch.

Two factors plausibly limit what the VLM can supply for this dataset: annotations given as Latin binomials rather than descriptive terms, and the limited representation of deep-sea organisms in general-purpose corpora relative to terrestrial fauna. We do not attempt to separate these.

blocks.en: We compare against a descriptor-matching baseline following Menon and Vondrick (2023) , which classifies images by their similarity to LLM-generated visual descriptors rather than to class names alone. Because the method produces flat outputs, we evaluate it both with and without the hierarchical constraint of section 3 .

blocks.en: For each of the 293 BN-Bio nodes, the VLM used elsewhere in our pipeline generates six visual descriptors, prompted with the node and its position in the hierarchy and restricted to appearance, giving 1,758 descriptors in total. Each descriptor is embedded once with the CLIP text encoder and scored against every image by cosine similarity, and a node’s score is the mean over its six descriptors. Normalisation and per-node thresholds are fitted on the 105,133 training images and applied unchanged to the 37,504 test images, so the baseline receives the same per-node thresholding as every model in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 对于293个BN-Bio节点,我们输油管别处使用的VLM产生6个可视描述符,由节点及其在等级中的地位所激发,并限于外观,总共给出了1,758个描述符. 每个描述符被嵌入过一次 CLIP 文本编码器,并且通过同位素相似度来对准每个图像,一个节点的分数是它的六个描述符的平均值. 105,133个培训图像上安装了规范化和每个节点阈值,37,504个测试图像没有变化,因此基准得到的每个节点阈值与表1中的每个模型相同。

blocks.en: The baseline reaches roughly half the macro F 1 F_{1} of the trained image branch and under a tenth of its d inv d_{\text{inv}} ( Table 11 ). Adding the hierarchical constraint leaves macro F 1 F_{1} unchanged and raises macro d inv d_{\text{inv}} from 0.12 to 0.17, while the sample-mean d inv d_{\text{inv}} stays at 0.11, so the gain falls on nodes that carry little weight in the sample mean.
blocks.zh: 基线大约达到训练有素的图像分支的宏F 1 F_{1},低于其d inv d_{\text{inv}}(表11)的十分之一。 加入分级约束使得宏F 1 F_{1}没有改变,将宏d inv d_{\text{inv}}}从0.12提高到0.17,而样本-mean d inv d_{\text{inv}}}则停留在0.11,因此增益落在了样本中重量不大的节点上.

blocks.en: The descriptors account for much of this. Of the 1,758 generated, 22.5% are verbatim duplicates of a descriptor issued for another node: smooth or slightly rough surface is assigned to 35 nodes and pale beige to brownish hue to 47. Duplication is most common between siblings, where 24% of the 769 sibling pairs share an identical descriptor. For example, Macroalgae > > Laminate > > Brown and > > Red receive five identical descriptors out of six, none of which mentions colour, although the prompt supplied both hierarchy paths and asked for distinguishing features. blocks.en: A natural notion of a “random” model in HML is one that predicts each node independently with uniform probability, analogous to the random baseline in multi-class classification. Such a model produces predictions with expected cardinality near | 𝒱 | / 2 |\mathcal{V}|/2 , where the number of combinatorial states is greatest. Crucially, the hierarchical constraint forces false positives to propagate upward since activating a node requires activating all of its ancestors. Consequently, higher-level nodes are disproportionately likely to be active. This stacking effect means that even moderate noise inflates cardinality rapidly. Both AP and F 1 F_{1} decay under this noise regime, and do so more steeply as hierarchy size grows, since the propagation affects a larger number of ancestor nodes in absolute terms. Recall, however, remains high throughout, because the noise mechanism adds false positives without removing true positives. Instead, the decrease in F 1 F_{1} is driven mostly by precision. By contrast, d inv d_{\text{inv}} falls off sharply under this noise, owing to its direct penalisation of excessive prediction cardinality, correctly reflecting that a model whose cardinality has inflated toward | 𝒱 | / 2 |\mathcal{V}|/2 retains little predictive value. The key point is not that one metric is right and the other wrong here, but that this regime is the only one in which AP behaves acceptably.
blocks.zh: HML中“随机”模型的自然概念是,以统一概率独立预测每个节点,类似于多类分类中的随机基线。 这种模型产生预测值的临界值在相邻的相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相相邻相相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 重要的是,等级限制迫使假阳性向上传播,因为激活节点需要激活其所有祖先。 因此,较高层级的节点活动的可能性不成比例。 这种堆叠效应意味着即使是中度噪声也迅速膨胀出红外线. blocks.en: Indeed, this type of performance degradation is almost never relevant in real-world scenarios. HML classification is a difficult problem because natural imbalances arise at deeper nodes ( Xu et al., 2026 ; Pereira et al., 2021 ) , with detection and recall falling in these specific and rare regions. In contrast, higher-level nodes, being more frequently observed, are rarely confused with one another. Instead, a realistic noise environment sharply increases the rate of false negatives with node depth, and only slightly increases false positives, which decrease with depth. Following these guidelines, we simulate data by generating synthetic hierarchies as in Algorithm 1 , with fictitious data generated using Algorithm 2 , and add noise with Algorithm 3 . The effects of the added noise are shown in Figure 6 . Our synthetic experiment targets an expected cardinality of three (to simulate the low cardinality and sparsity of benthic data). We tested five distinct hierarchies at each of five sizes (25 hierarchies in total), with 500 data points per hierarchy. The noise levels spanned 0.0 0.0 to 1.0 1.0 in 0.1 0.1 increments.
blocks.zh: 实际上,在现实世界的情景中,这种绩效退化几乎从不相关。 HML分类是一个困难的问题,因为自然不平衡出现在更深的节点上(徐等,2026;佩雷拉等,2021),在这些特定而稀有的区域中发现并召回. 相形之下,较高层次的节点被更频繁地观测到,很少互相混淆. 取而代之的是,现实的噪声环境使有节点深度的假负数的速率急剧上升,而只略微地会增加假正数,而假正数随深度而下降. 根据这些准则,我们通过生成合成分级数据来模拟数据,如在算法1中,使用算法2生成的虚构数据,并用算法3添加噪音。 新增噪音的影响见图6。 我们的合成实验的目标是预期的3个核心(模拟底栖数据的低核心和垃圾)。 我们测试了五个不同的等级,每个等级为五个(共25个等级),每个等级有500个数据点。 在0.1增量中,噪声水平从0.0到1.01.0.

blocks.en: In this more realistic setting ( Figure 7 ), we observe that AP is both insensitive to disruptive noise and misleading as to model quality, leading to an optimistic overestimation of model performance. This behaviour matches results in existing studies ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Giunchiglia and Lukasiewicz, 2020 ; Pereira et al., 2021 ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . AP behaves this way because of the sparsity of nodes in large hierarchies. Low ground-truth cardinality means that the vast majority of nodes are inactive for any given sample. Micro-average AP computes precision and recall across all node-sample pairs simultaneously, so by its inability to distinguish the trivial discrimination of inactive nodes from the genuinely difficult and important task of detecting active ones, the metric becomes inflated. On the other hand, d inv d_{\text{inv}} is not susceptible to this inflation because it operates directly on predicted and ground-truth cardinalities. Consequently, d inv d_{\text{inv}} degrades more steeply than both F 1 F_{1} and AP as noise intensifies, reflecting the practical reality that the model has lost its ability to resolve the fine-grained distinctions important to HML classification.
blocks.zh: 在这种更为现实的环境下(图7),我们看到AP既对破坏性噪音不敏感,又对模型质量产生误导,导致对模型性能的乐观高估. 这种行为与现有的研究相匹配(徐等,2024;Giunchiglia和Lukasiewicz,2020;Pereira等,2021;徐等,2026)。 AP由于大分级中节点的抽筋而表现得如此. 低地-地真临界值意味着,对于任何特定样本来说,绝大多数节点都是不活跃的. 微平均值AP计算精确度和在所有节点-样本对上同时被召回,因此,由于它无法区分非活动节点的细微差别和探测活性节点的真正困难而重要的任务,计量标准变得夸大. 另一方面,d inv d_{\text{inv}}}并不会受到这种通货膨胀的影响,因为它直接在预测和地面真相上运作。 因此,d inv d_{\text{inv}}}的降解比F 1 F_{1}和AP 的降解都更尖锐,因为噪音变强,反映了该模型丧失了解决对HML分类至关重要的精细区分能力的实际现实。

The divergence between the two metrics in these scenarios stems from a fundamental design difference. Because h ​ F 1 hF_{1} operates on ancestor-expanded sets without solving an explicit assignment between predicted and true labels, any overlap in ancestral paths contributes positively to both precision and recall, regardless of whether those shared ancestors reflect genuine predictive accuracy or are simply artefacts of the hierarchical structure. In shallow hierarchies with few shared ancestors this effect can be minor, but in deep or broad hierarchies it can substantially dampen the penalty for spurious predictions. By contrast, d inv d_{\text{inv}} isolates the best possible matching through the assignment problem and then applies the cardinality factor γ \gamma , which decays monotonically with the number of excess predictions. This ensures that cardinality violations are penalised in proportion to their severity, independently of where in the hierarchy the spurious predictions happen to fall. We view this property as particularly important for applications where downstream decisions depend on the precise set of predicted labels rather than merely on their neighbourhood in the hierarchy.
blocks.zh: 这些假设中两个衡量标准之间的差异源于基本的设计差异。 由于h F 1 hF_{1}在祖先扩展的套件上运作,而未解决预测和真实标签之间的明确分配,故祖道上的任何重叠都积极促进精确性和召回性,无论这些共同祖先是否反映真实的预测准确性,还是只是等级结构的手工艺品. 在少有共同祖先的浅层等级中,这种影响可能不大,但在深层或广泛的等级中,这种影响可以大大减轻对虚假预测的惩罚。 相比之下,d inv d_{\text{inv}}}通过分配问题隔离出尽可能最好的匹配,然后应用criminality因子 γ\gamma,它与超量预测的数量会单调地衰变. 这确保了对重大侵权行为的惩罚与其严重程度成正比,而与等级体系中虚假的预测发生在何处无关。 我们认为,这种财产对于下游决定取决于准确的一套预测标签而不是仅仅取决于其在等级体系中的邻近地区的申请特别重要。

blocks.en: This leniency has been identified independently. Falis et al. (2021) observe the same structural property in set-based hierarchical evaluation, of which h ​ F 1 hF_{1} is an instance. Because the expanded sets are unions, several predicted descendants of a common ancestor reduce to a single entry, and the measure does not consider how many predictions reach the ancestor. They address this by propagating descendant counts rather than truth values, and report that the resulting measure returns consistently lower scores than set-based evaluation across three trained models on the MIMIC-III ICD-9 task, attributing the gap to over- and under-prediction within families of codes that set-based evaluation cannot express.

blocks.en: Three edge cases for d inv d_{\text{inv}} are defined as follows. Where no path exists between a ground-truth endpoint and a predicted one, as is the case between disjoint roots, the pairwise similarity is set to zero rather than left undefined.
